selection: Two largest post-200 fitted-c errors among all 107 development scans, chosen before new profiles
method: Fixed-bank, fixed 200/100 Hz clock priors; <=250m reference continuation; both c arms share fitted-c initial seed; at most two same-point warm retries after nonstationarity; release final reference position if continuation succeeds
budget: 20 seconds and 600 iterations per fit; at most 20 steps plus initial point, three attempts per point per arm
reference_use: Oracle diagnostics only; never operational initialization or winner selection
next_action: Use score decomposition to distinguish model preference from missed nuisance minima; do not promote any reference-assisted result
